questions.q: What was Jack Welch's primary mission for GE?
a: Be number one or two in each market
questions.why: He set the goal to be top two in every market.

questions.q: How does Welch view annual budgeting?
questions.why: He argues fixed budgets can stop growth.

questions.q: What budgeting alternative does Welch propose?
questions.why: He suggests adjusting budgets as you go.

questions.q: What career advice does Welch give about job changes?
a: Switch jobs often to find passion
questions.why: He encourages trying different jobs to discover love.

questions.q: What was the size of Welch's severance payment?
questions.why: He received the largest severance of $417 million.
